Subject: Summit Bottle is back — 2 left in stock
Preview: 750 ml, 24-hour cold retention. Grab one before they're gone again.
Body: You checked it out. Now it's back.

The Northbay Summit Insulated Bottle (NB-BTL-03) is restocked — and we're down to 2 units.

Here's what it does:

• 750 ml capacity — enough for a half-day push without a refill stop
• Double-wall stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, hot for 12
• Built for trail and camp use; not designed for technical alpine or submersion scenarios

No discount. No pitch. Just a heads-up that stock is thin and this one tends to move fast when it comes back.

If it fits your next trip, now's the time.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
